department: Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering

app_fee.value: No application fee for the chemical engineering PhD.
app_fee.quote: There is no fee to apply to the PhD program.

gre_general.value: The department does not require the GRE General Test; scores may be reported.
gre_general.quote: The Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering does not require the GRE General Test

gre_subject.value: The GRE subject test is not required.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE subject test is not required.

toefl_min.quote: The School of Science and Engineering requires a minimum score of 80.

ielts_min.value: School of Science and Engineering minimum: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum overall band score on IELTS Academic: 7.0.

supervisor.value: Advised to identify at least one faculty member whose research matches theirs before applying.
supervisor.quote: it is helpful to identify at least one faculty member who has a background and research in the area in which you are most interested in studying

funding.value: All admitted doctoral students receive full financial aid: tuition plus a stipend.
funding.quote: Full financial aid (tuition + stipend) is given to all students admitted to the Doctoral Program.

entry_route.value: Applicants need an undergraduate degree before starting; no master's is listed as required.
entry_route.quote: Earned an undergraduate degree from an accredited institution prior to the first semester of proposed graduate study

deadline.value: Due December 31 before Fall entry for full consideration; the School table lists January 15, 2027.
deadline.quote: Applications for Fall admissions are due by December 31 of the preceding year

english_waiver.value: An English-medium bachelor's degree does not waive the test; TOEFL or IELTS is required for international applicants.
english_waiver.quote: TOEFL or IELTS scores are required for all international applicants regardless of language of instruction for your bachelor’s degree.

notes: The department FAQ says the School requires TOEFL 80; the School's own page says 87. The department value is used. The department FAQ lists no IELTS minimum, so the School's IELTS 7.0 applies.
